descriptionChirho: A Levitical city in the territory of Dan, later contested between Israel and the Philistines. The three clusters are purely prepositional variants of the same toponym: bare form, with conjunctive waw ('and Gibbethon'), and with preposition min ('from Gibbethon'). All translations confirm a single place name: Spanish 'Gibetón', Hindi 'गिब्बतोन', Arabic 'جِبِّتُونَ' (Jibbitun), Korean '깁벳데/깃버뇌', Swahili 'Gibethoni'. Mentioned in Joshua 19:44, 21:23 as a Levitical city, and in 1 Kings 15:27, 16:15-17 as the location where Baasha and Zimri conspired against the kings of Israel.
